item.title: [6.0] SAGE: Sense-Aligned Multimodal Grounding Evaluation with Gloss-Augmented Reasoning
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

This paper introduces Sense-Aligned Grounding Evaluation (SAGE), a unified 10-candidate image-selection benchmark that reformulates VWSD, VerSe, and WikiDiverse into a shared term-centric protocol covering noun-, verb-, and entity-centered grounding. SAGE includes confusable hard negatives and a context-swapped VerSe diagnostic to probe target-term grounding beyond direct caption--image...

WHY IT MATTERS

Advances fundamental language model capabilities, reasoning efficiency, or training methodology.
